name: gmp-real-estate-static-vanilla-js
description: Split-Screen Real Estate Search, Parcel Polygon & Commute Explorer built with Static HTML + Vanilla JavaScript (Zero-Bundler ES Modules) and Google Maps Platform.

scripts.build: node --check app.js && node --check server.mjs && node -e "import('node:fs').then(fs=>{['index.html','styles.css','app.js','server.mjs'].forEach(f=>{if(!fs.existsSync(f))throw new Error('Missing '+f);});console.log('Static vanilla JS build verified.');})"
